title: Seeking that learns to dwell
subtitle: A short return when holy hunger is turning into novelty
description: A brief path for bringing the search back to sangat, Naam, and obedience before spiritual hunger becomes another appetite.

heroSource.shortMeaning: The wandering mind settles in the Society of the Saints, where mercy begins to enlighten the search.
heroSource.lifeApplication: Stay with one true instruction long enough for seeking to become practice.

evidence.coreClaim: This bundle separates holy hunger from restless consumption.
evidence.turn: Seeking deepens when it stops collecting and begins dwelling.
evidence.practicalImplication: Keep one teaching today instead of hunting for a new one.
